Hong Kong: the city's gold central clearing system completed its July trial with what the Chief Executive called an enthusiastic market response, and still targets Q1 2027 for full launch, he said Tuesday at the Global Financial Leaders' Investment Summit.

行政長官李家超週二在國際金融領袖投資峰會表示，香港黃金中央清算及結算系統七月起已完成試運，市場反養熱烈，計劃於明年第一季度正式推出；交割連接系統將對接上海黃金交易所，並與倫敦金鋷市場協會標準接軌。

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.

Gold in Hong Kong this week: HK$36,855 a tael, HK$985 a gram, silver HK$12,428 a kilogram — an intraday mark from the tape, 3 November 13:51 ET, the first reading since 30 October.
